svg.style: background-color: #0b1120; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
svg.text: CIM8Bits Top-Level, Version B (Programmable Switch Mesh Between Compute Tiles)
Tiles are mesh endpoints; the 2D mesh nodes are programmable switches that route Out Reg results to the In Reg of any destination tile (N=8, 8N = 64 bit)
ISA: LOAD · MATVEC · RELU · SEND · ROUTE · SYNC
SEND tags a result with its destination tile id
Control / Config Bus (tile cfg + route tables)
Load / Store Data Bus (matrix, vector, result)
Each switch matches the dst tile id of a word against its Route Table and picks N / E / S / W / Local; Local writes the attached tile's In Reg. Mesh edge ports are tied off.
